data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $10.5m, (2015: $1.1m favourable).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was $133.625m. Using the gross claims development triangle the syndicate shows a net prior-year strengthening of approximately $21.18m (about 15.85% of opening gross claims), driven primarily by adverse development on older underwriting years and large/ discrete losses. The movement was calculated from the gross claims development table; narrative references to prior year "claims incurred" (e.g. $10.5m) relate to P&L claims incurred measures and differ from the gross reserve development derived from the triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: an increase in discrete and non-correlated large risk losses in the second half of 2016
further softening of both premium rates and market terms and conditions across almost all classes of business
In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $10.5m, (2015: $1.1m favourable).

Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances. Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its recourse for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions table (explicit). No explicit single-line 'gross prior year movement' was provided; prior-year movement was calculated from the Gross Claims Development Triangle (page 47). The report also contains a narrative saying 'prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $10.5m' but that phrase refers to claims incurred (P&L) not the movement in gross reserves; therefore the triangle-based gross movement (21.18m USD) was used. All amounts reported in native USD and converted to millions. Confidence reflects direct table reads (1.0) and calculated triangle result (0.8).
